description: Measured native public-world geometry optimization. Only compatible opaque groups sharing the exact native material object merge; transparent groups keep their original Mesh ID, transform, materials, ordering and full collision vertex/index data. Source geometry is restored by reference before material edits/disposal.

syntheticTransparentTieTest.note: Synthetic overlapping geometry validates exact equal-depth transparent sorting; it is distinct from the actual native FBX and live-domain proofs.

realNativeTextureTest.asset: Packaged native default mannequin FBX and embedded PNG textures
realNativeTextureTest.note: The captured native body geometry is frozen as three static meshes for this batching-only test; this does not claim an avatar/world session.

coverage: exact material identity and layout exclusion
mixed transparency original Mesh and geometry restore

liveFirefoxFluidnessAfterThisChange: Passed all strict loaded-world, keyboard walking and fully loaded rejoin gates in stock Firefox156 and Chromium154; see public-hub-fluid.json for exact measurements, native agreement and runtime attestation.

regressions: Registered native mask callbacks and their actual helper-created clones preserve exact oriented corners/material identity and same-material draw saving.
Fractional-alpha residual groups retain the original Mesh identity, complete collision indices, material selectors and exact restoration while opaque groups batch.
Forged nativeAlpha userData and copied callback pairs on unregistered materials remain rejected. Modifying either callback of registered materials invalidates the exception.
